News Meet The Cohort AIMA Opex AIMA Opex As part of our AI Venture Forge “Meet the Cohort” series, we’re excited to introduce AIMA Opex, a company bringing intelligence to the heart of factory operations, without requiring a digital overhaul.
With over 60% of SMEs still relying on checklists, and whiteboards, AIMA’s AI-powered platform layers smart guidance and quality control onto existing workflows.
Website Company | Manufacturing AI What inspired you to build an Industrial AI for manufacturers?
At AIMA OPEX, we’re a team of engineers, scientists, and builders who’ve spent our careers both on the factory floor and in advanced AI research.
I’m Asem Mohammad, Founder of AIMA, a Chartered Engineer with 15 years of experience in the manufacturing sector.

AIMA was born from the belief that AI-driven intelligence should be accessible, scalable, and deeply integrated into the manufacturing process, not to replace human expertise but to augment and empower the workforce.
AIMA addresses a global, high-value problem: quality failures in manual manufacturing.
This is a $1.3 trillion annual loss globally – manufacturers are losing up to 30% revenue per year due to quality failures, with the average SMEs bleeding 300K annually.
AIMA is an AI-powered software that helps manufacturers reduce mistakes during production as they happen, not after – avoiding rework & downstream issues by up to 50%.
We believe the Venture Forge programme will accelerate our progress toward key milestones by providing structured mentorship, expert feedback, and valuable peer discussions.
The extensive network offered by Venture Forge is opening doors to key decision-makers within our ideal customer profile, notably innovation-focused manufacturing leaders within the region.
Over 60% of SMEs still rely on paper-based SOPs, checklists, and whiteboards.

News Meet The Cohort Forge Robotics Forge Robotics As part of our AI Venture Forge “Meet the Cohort” series, we’re thrilled to feature one of the most forward-thinking startups tackling one of manufacturing’s most pressing crises: Forge Robotics.
They’re not just automating tasks – they’re redefining how robots think, with a bold, AI-first approach to welding automation.
Website Company | Robotics AI What problem are you solving in manufacturing with robot “brains”?
We are tackling one of the most urgent threats to global manufacturing, the skilled labour shortage.
To solve this, we are giving manufacturing robots the brains that they have been missing.

Our AI-powered system gives robots the perception, adaptability, and decision-making needed to work like a human: scan the part, understand the geometry, and execute welds, without needing everything to be perfect.
In theory, AI could be retrofitted onto existing welding robots, but in practice, most industrial cells aren’t built for it.
Instead, we’re designing Forge as a full-stack AI-native welding system: a modular cobot-based cell built from off-the-shelf hardware, outfitted with our own perception and motion intelligence.
How will the AI Venture Forge mentorship help you refine your go-to-market?
The people that we will meet and those who we get connected to will be the reason that we move towards getting our product working on manufacturing floors in weeks not years.
We know that the technology we are building and the industry we are breaking into need the right connections, and we believe we can make many of them here at AI Venture Forge.
What barriers have you encountered around the adoption of AI-driven robotics?

News Meet The Cohort Shoden AI Shoden aI As part of our AI Venture Forge “Meet the Cohort” series, we’re excited to introduce Shoden AI, a company on a mission to transform sales through full-cycle automation.

Shoden AI takes the manual grind out of prospecting by automating every stage of the outbound process, from identifying and researching leads to crafting personalised messages, managing follow-ups, and scheduling meetings.
At Shoden AI, we recognised a critical gap in sales development.
We created Nezumi to address this challenge by automating outbound sales with an AI-driven solution.
Nezumi acts as a personal AI SDR that can handle lead generation, outreach, and follow-ups, all while being more affordable and much more efficient than a human counterpart.
How does your AI SDR differ from other sales automation tools?

Early customers have seen impressive results with Shoden AI.
These figures reflect the high-quality outreach that Shoden AI enables.
Customers also report significant reductions in their sales development costs, with our AI SDR being 5x cheaper and 2x more productive compared to human SDRs.
